sourceSectionTitle: FILLING EXTRAORDINARY VACANCIES OF ALL COMMISSIONERS AND THE MAYOR

whatItDoes: The Charter currently authorizes the Governor to fill vacancies if all commissioners, including the mayor, are removed from office. Shall the Charter be amended to provide for the City Manager, or Assistant City Manager, to appoint a mayor and two commissioners, for those appointees to appoint two additional members of the commission, and for the interim commission to call a Special Election if there is more than 180 calendar days remaining in the unexpired term(s)?
